name: activity-3
title: Audit Log With Icon Tiles
description: Audit log feed with action-type icon tiles, a two-line event title and detail, a type tag, and a timestamp, with no avatars.

standards.purpose: Show what happened, in order, with enough context to act on it.
useWhen: A workspace, profile, or admin surface needs a history of events.
doNotUseWhen: The same information is already the primary content of the page.

rules.check: Every event names its actor, its action, and a timestamp that resolves to an absolute time.
Order newest first unless the surface is explicitly a progress timeline.
An empty feed states why it is empty and what will appear.
